snippet.title: Valkyrie - Galaxy on Fire 2 add-on for iPhone and iPad by FISHLABS - Teaser HD
snippet.description: Valkyrie™, the first official add-on to Galaxy on Fire 2™, is finally coming to iPhone and iPad on April 28th 2011 and to Android and Nokia high-end smartphones later this year. All space ship footage captured from in-game graphics and showing original gameplay. The Valkyrie™ add-on offers a thrilling new storyline along with plenty of new spaceships, weapons, and equipment.
